svg.title: Bessel-Thomson receive filter and noise bandwidth
svg.desc: Squared magnitude of the 4th-order Bessel-Thomson filter with -3 dB at 26.6 GHz. A shaded rectangle of height 1 and width B_n = 27.8 GHz has the same area: white noise passes the filter as if it had this ideal bandwidth.
